cases.title: A null added at the top mid-lesson renumbers Title; shaping it is still graded on Title and passes

rubric.reason: Turn 2 opens with "That passes: all three of Title's Position moves and its Scale". It mentions the null plainly, without calling it a problem or bringing up layer order, and ends on the read-again question "where is the move fastest now".

Every name and time in both turns comes from the tool results, the record or the learner. Title, its Position pairs 0.5–1.5, 1.5–3 and 3–4.37 s, its Scale 0.5–1.5 s, Old Take, CTRL, Icon, Logo's Rotation, Subtitle's Opacity, Bar's X Position and Glow's Blurriness all appear in the snapshot and record, and the null on top is the learner's own words.

Turn 1 is the proposal with one-line leave-outs and ends on the land-hard question. Turn 2 is a short pass handover with one allowed plain sentence about the null, and ends on the read-again question "near the start, in the middle, or near the end?".
